ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future scheme
questions: How much money was involved in the Feeding Our Future scheme?
What other entities or programs are connected to the scheme?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover additional entities or programs involved in the scheme and identify potential vulnerabilities in the system.
